invoices.ts
createExcelSchema<Invoice>()
  .column("customer", { accessor: "client.name" })
  .column("qty", { accessor: "qty" })
  .column("price", { accessor: "unitPrice" })
  .column("total", {
    formula: ({ refs }) =>
      refs.column("qty").mul(refs.column("price")),    summary: (s) => [s.formula("sum")],
  })
